title: Pin the reviewed native job design under the oracle milestone with one script run (execution/scripts/pin_native_262.py)
body:
## Goal
Review #262 accepted the landed design-only native job contract (benchmark/native/ + benchmark/scripts/native_jobs.py) with no findings. The Policymaker wrote a hash-gated idempotent script that adds the four files to the oracle milestone of benchmark/preparation.json, appends one limitation sentence (design only, zero native executions, #169 not ready, same GPT-family author/reviewer) to benchmark/preparation-status.json and re-pins its references. Dry run on a copy of main: idempotent, evaluator missing [] with 55 refs, status sha 5c972a14..., preparation.json sha d4a37c5f.... Expected gain: the reviewed native design is pinned evidence; the next Policymaker checks main evaluator --check reports 55 references and preparation-status.json sha starts 5c972a14.
## Acceptance
- [ ] Turn 1: write `.session/report.md` (status wip).
- [ ] Run exactly once: `python3 -I execution/scripts/pin_native_262.py`. If it exits non-zero, report the output and stop; do not fix by hand.
- [ ] Run the Verification command; record its exit code, `evidence_references` and `missing` in the report; set status done.
- [ ] Change nothing else: only benchmark/preparation.json and benchmark/preparation-status.json may change; no `__pycache__`; do not run `git commit` (the parent commits).
## Verification
`python3 policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check`
## Context
- execution/scripts/pin_native_262.py: the whole procedure.
## Budget
- At most 6 tool calls. Do not read recipes.json, case JSON or results JSON.
